authority_bases.meaning: AI-drafted intent only; cannot activate a relationship or grant.
Explicit patient approval in this synthetic prototype; not legal authority.

legal_authority_statuses.meaning: No identity proofing, legal review, MPOA, guardianship, or other legal authority determination is represented.

purposes.meaning: Coordinate bounded non-clinical or patient-directed care activities.
Manage appointment-related activity within an allowed application.

semantic_invariants: AI output is always draft and can never be active, approved, or authorized.
A patient invite proves only control of a synthetic invited account.
Invite acceptance alone does not establish patient consent or activate a delegation.
A personal relationship assertion does not grant application permission.
A patient-approved delegation grant does not establish legal authority.
RelatedPerson-like relationship semantics remain separate from consent and delegation scope.
Excluded resources can never also be allowed; exclusions win.
Every action requires its declared resource category.
Every application applies its own audience, purpose, action, resource, validity, and status policy.
Recipient contact values are never retained in plaintext by the invite contract.
